      "summary": "bulkSetChannelPolicies uses the caller supplied organizationKey as both the stable Slack organization key and the durable organizations/workspaces organizationId.",
      "details": "At exact integration HEAD 3fadece4758f0e122afebeabac01a3260c1743c8, packages/convex/confect/slack/channelPolicies.impl.ts reads sourceChannels and channel policy rows by input.organizationKey, but loadPolicyActor authorizes organizationMembers.by_organization_user and Client Brain target discovery queries workspaces.by_organization_kind using that same input value as organizationId. Existing Slack/source tables are keyed by stable organizationKey values such as an agency key, while organizationMembers and workspaces use the durable organization _id. This means a real admin cannot be authorized for the provider/source organizationKey, and changing the input to an _id would miss source/policy rows. The pure planner tests do not exercise this Confect authorization/persistence seam, so the public mutation is unusable or incorrectly scoped at the tenant boundary."
